Built around how hiring managers read

Hiring managers scan a resume for about 10 seconds. We make sure yours shows your best work first.

Free 10-minute review

Quick scan and bullet structure fixes

The 10-second scan and layout order

Hiring managers scan a resume for roughly 10 seconds first. We check section order, font legibility, consistent date alignment, and whether your strongest design work sits near the top.

Turn daily duties into proof with numbers

Instead of opening bullets with "responsible for", build each key bullet around three parts (action verb, what you shipped, and the number or user outcome) so hiring teams see what you built and what moved.

$ Premium 45m session

Target role and keyword alignment

During the active 45-minute session, we pull exact skills, tools, and product terms from your target job postings and rewrite your background summary and bullets together live.

$ Premium 45m session

ATS cleanup and live draft editing

Catch nested columns, tables, and skill bars that scramble Applicant Tracking Systems, verify clean PDF text selection, and finish your top edits hands-on during the 45-minute call.

How the 10-minute session works

Add a link to your resume so it can be reviewed before the meeting. Pick a time, then we’ll walk through it together on the call.

  1. Share resume

    Step 1

    Have your 1 or 2 page resume open as a PDF, Figma frame, or Google Doc, alongside one job posting you want to apply for.

  2. Pick a time

    Step 2

    Book a free 10-minute call or the $20 active 45-minute session. Available times adjust automatically to your local timezone.

  3. Join the call

    Step 3

    Share your screen for a live layout scan, bullet rewrites, and ATS checks so you know exactly what to fix after the call.

Questions, answered

Details on the free 10-minute resume review and applying as a mentor.

What is included in the free call vs. the $20 Premium session?

The free 10-minute call covers your 10-second layout scan and turning daily duties into proof with numbers, with no payment details needed. The $20 Premium option is an active 45-minute session covering target role keyword alignment, ATS cleanup, and live draft editing.

Who reviews my resume?

Sessions are hosted by Anna Jiwon Lee, a Product and Experience Designer with 5 years of experience across B2C web, mobile products, and design systems, along with practicing industry mentors.

Who can book a session?

Product Designers and career switchers preparing a design resume, from recent graduates to senior designers.

What makes a strong experience bullet?

Instead of opening bullets with "responsible for", build each key bullet around three parts (action verb, what you built, and the number or user outcome) so hiring teams see what you shipped and what moved.

Where do we meet and which timezone is shown?

Calls take place on Google Meet from anywhere. Google Calendar shows open times in your local timezone.

Why switch from a three-column layout to one column?

Multi-column layouts and graphical skill bars often scramble reading order in Applicant Tracking Systems and squeeze experience bullets into narrow strips. A clean single-column layout in one font gives hiring managers a clear Background summary and Experience bullets with numbers first.
